content:
Priya (Customer): Hey team, urgent — our production app started throwing shape errors this morning. Hosted embeddings endpoint returns vectors of length 1536, but our Dedicated cluster is producing 768-dim vectors. This breaks the downstream indexer. Error: "ShapeMismatch: expected 1536, got 768". We did not change client code. Please help.

Mia (Support): Sorry you're seeing that — we'll triage. Which model name/alias are you calling in each environment (hosted vs dedicated)? Any request IDs or sample requests? Also did you try the Private deployment?

Priya (Customer): Thanks. Hosted call uses model `redwood-embeddings-3-small` via hosted API key. Dedicated uses the same alias in our config (we thought alias maps to same model). Example request we send:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embeddings-3-small","input":"query text here"}'
```

Response (hosted): `{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...] } ] }`
Response (dedicated): `{"data":[{"embedding":[...768 floats...] } ] }`. No retries from client. Request IDs: hosted `req_h_20250426_01`, dedicated `req_d_20250426_07`. Also our billing dashboard shows a spike around the same time (extra reprocessing jobs?), not sure if related.

Ashish (ENG): Thanks Priya, good info. Quick possibilities: 1) alias mapping drift (alias points to different model versions on different control planes), 2) quantized variant being served on Dedicated with different embedding head, or 3) older model package deployed to Dedicated. Can you confirm the exact `model` field string and the SDK/client version? Also did you set `accept_sparse=false` or any special headers?

Sam (ML Eng): One other thing — we have two embedding families in prod: `emb-3-small` (1536) and `emb-3-legacy` (768). If aliasing was changed during a rollout, that could explain parity. From an ML perspective, embedding dimension should be stable for a model family; mismatch indicates different variants.

Priya (Customer): We pin `model` to `redwood-embeddings-3-small` in our config. SDK v2.1.0 on both environments. No special headers. I can share curl output and the raw embedding lengths. Hosted sample: `len=1536`. Dedicated sample: `len=768`. I also see latency difference: Hosted ~120ms, Dedicated ~650ms.

Mia (Support): Copying infra and ML: @Ashish (ENG) @Sam (ML Eng) @Eva (SRE) — can you confirm if there was any alias change or emergency rollback earlier today? We'll also open a billing triage if the spike is customer-facing.

InfraBot: deploy-bot posted: `deployment redwood-embeddings-3-small v2025-04-25 rolled back on dedicated-cluster-12 at 2025-04-26T08:12:00Z`

Ashish (ENG): Hmm that rollback looks relevant. Dedicated cluster shows a rollback to `v2024-12-15` which might be the legacy build with 768 head. I'll check the alias table. Priya, can you include the full `model` string exactly as in your requests (any extra whitespace or different casing can cause alias resolution differences)?

Priya (Customer): Exact body we send (safe-for-sharing): `{"model":"redwood-embeddings-3-small","input":["alpha","beta"]}`. No casing differences.

Sam (ML Eng): Reproduced locally against a dedicated test cluster following the deploy-bot note. I see the same 768-dim vectors when hitting the pre-rollback artifact. It does look like the rollback replaced the model package with a legacy variant. That would also explain the latency delta — the older package isn't optimized for current kernels.

Eva (SRE): From infra metrics: dedicated-cluster-12 autoscaler triggered under memory pressure during the rollback window, fallback to older instance types happened. That could have caused an automated rollback due to health checks failing on the new package.

Mia (Support): Ok. Short-term workaround for Priya: explicitly set `model` to the fully-qualified model version (e.g., `redwood/redwood-embeddings-3-small@v2025-04-24`) in your request to avoid alias resolution across different control planes until we fix alias drift. Can you try that and paste the result?

Priya (Customer): Trying now...

Priya (Customer): With `"model":"redwood/redwood-embeddings-3-small@v2025-04-24"` Dedicated returns 1536-dim vectors. Hosted unchanged. So temporary workaround works. But we need a permanent fix — alias consistency across hosted/dedicated/private must be reliable. Also can we get the billing spike explained — we were charged for extra embedding calls when we retried some jobs after the error.

Ashish (ENG): Root cause summary so far: dedicated cluster rollback pulled an older artifact where the embedding head output dim=768. Aliases on dedicated control plane pointed to the rollback artifact, while hosted stayed on the newer v2025 build (1536). We'll: 1) Add an alias consistency check between control planes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), 2) Add a validation in the runtime that rejects mismatched embedding dims with a clear 4xx (instead of silently returning old shape), and 3) Add alerting when an artifact rollback changes model schema.

Sam (ML Eng): For implementation: validation is straightforward — compare embedding schema in model metadata at load time and enforce. Also we should expose a `schema` field in the model catalog endpoint so customers can fetch dims pre-flight.

Eva (SRE): Actions on infra: investigate why rollback happened (healthchecks/logs), ensure artifact promotion blocks auto-rollbacks that change model schema, and add a pre-deploy check to compare `model.metadata.embedding_dim` with catalog.

Mia (Support): Billing: Priya — I'll open a billing escalation and request a one-time credit for duplicate embedding charges tied to the retry window. Can you confirm time window (approx)?

Priya (Customer): Window is between 2025-04-26 08:10–08:40 UTC. We retried a handful of failed index jobs which likely caused duplicates. Thanks for opening billing ticket.

Mia (Support): Done — ticket #BILL-2025-581 opened. Escalating to finance.

InfraBot: ticket-tracker: `BILL-2025-581 created by Mia (Support)`

Ashish (ENG): I'll own the alias consistency fix. ETA 2 business days for detection + 1 week for automatic reconciliation across control planes. Sam will own schema validation in runtime (PR planned). Eva to lead postmortem on rollback triggers. Mia to coordinate updates with Priya and confirm credit.

Priya (Customer): Appreciate the quick help. One additional ask — can you add a preflight endpoint we can hit to validate model dims before bulk jobs? If you can expose model/schema metadata that would help avoid breaking batch runs.

Sam (ML Eng): Yep we'll add `GET /models/{model}/metadata` returning `embedding_dim` and quantization capabilities. I'll prioritize that.

Mia (Support): Next steps summary: 
- Priya: share any additional request IDs if you see more mismatches (owner: Priya).
- Mia: billing ticket follow-up and customer updates (owner: Mia).
- Ashish: alias consistency check and reconciliation plan (owner: Ashish).
- Sam: runtime schema validation + public model metadata endpoint (owner: Sam).
- Eva: rollback postmortem and infra guardrails (owner: Eva).

Priya (Customer): Thanks all. I'll monitor and revert if anything else pops up. :pray:

Ashish (ENG): I'll post progress updates here. Thanks for the repro steps — huge help.

InfraBot: deploy-bot posted: `rollout started for redwood-embeddings-3-small v2025-04-26 on dedicated-cluster-12`

Mia (Support): Closing the immediate ticket since workaround applied and owners assigned. Will re-open if Priya reports further problems.

Priya (Customer): Confirming fixed for now. Thanks everyone.
